svg.title: Victim loss by deposit size after a 10,000 token donation: the naive vault loses 100% below 10,000 tokens then follows a sawtooth, OpenZeppelin offset 0 loses 100% up to 5,000 tokens and up to 33% below 10,000, while dead shares, offset 6 and internal accounting never exceed 0.1%
svg.text: Victim's loss by deposit size, after a 10,000 token donation
OpenZeppelin's default offset still loses everything below 5,000 tokens; the real defences never pass 0.1%.
Where the lines overlap, the blue OpenZeppelin line runs inside the orange naive line. 100 to 40,000 token deposits.
Exact integer model of the repo's vaults (erc4626_model.py); it reproduces every Foundry result in the README.
